html:
Update8 July 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - Jul 8, 2026
This week's update introduces the first craftable Thunderwing Titan weapon, significant improvements to Red Dragon equipment and the Devastator, the return of the Rum Runner's Rapids festival, and a wide range of gameplay improvements and bug fixes.

WBC 1 Feedback

We appreciate all of the feedback we have been given through the first week of the World Boss Cycle: Tempest. Trust us, it'd be hard for us to miss. We'd like to let the dynamic timers created by the world boss eggs play out for just a bit longer, and in the meantime we are introducing some changes to make existing world boss items a bit more useful. Any and all feedback is appreciated, especially when it is constructively delivered. Thanks everyone!

Features

  • Rum Runner's Rapids Festival has been activated in Rookborne Basin! This will be running from July 8th to July 22nd (or the maintenance after that)
  • The Howling Thundergod's Staff has been added to the game.
    • Acquired through combining materials dropped by Thunderwing Titan
    • The recipe is available at the Thunderwing Alchemy Workbench in Reedwind's camp
    • This is the first of a series of weapons that will be crafted from Thunderwing Titan drops.
    • Effects:
      • Passive - Increases all Lightning-Based Sorcery Skills Damage by +9%
      • Active - Fire up to 5 lightning artillery bolts up to 50 metres away, dealing (3250 + 290% Magic Attack) Damage. User is slowed by 15% for each remaining shot. Requires the staff to be equipped.
  • A number of Red Dragon's weapons have had their actives improved.
    • Berserk Red Dragon Roar (Staff)
      • 2.0s -> 1.5s cast time
      • +20% damage increase
      • 3m -> 5m radius of AOE
      • Combo: Deal 20% more damage to enemies affected by chilling or ice effects.
    • Berserk Red Dragon's Wing-Reaper (Nodachi)
      • +30% damage increase
      • Inflicts Wing-Clipped instead of Slow:
        • 5s duration
        • 30% Slow
        • Affected targets cannot glide during the duration.
    • Berserk Red Dragon Fireguard (Shield)
      • +3,000 -> +4,500 health regenerated over 10 seconds.
      • Fears all nearby enemies within 6m for up to 3 seconds.
    • Berserk Red Dragon Tail-Reaper (Sword)
      • Channeling is no longer required for continuing the effect. Functions similarly to Crippling Mire.
      • Reduced scaling from Magic Attack, added base damage to the skill.
      • Effect now also slows attack speed and cast speed.
  • The Red Dragon's Devastator has had its defenses reinforced.
    • 15% damage reduction against all types of damage excluding siege
    • Now immune to Red Dragon's meteorites.
    • Small amount of in-combat health regeneration has been added.
    • Cooldown has been reduced when engaging siege mode.
  • The Red Dragon's Doom now has a salvage option similar to building material packs. Players will be returned a Hardened Red Dragon Scale when salvaged. No more porting away to drop pillaged harpoons!
  • World Boss Spawners (Eggs, Gong) now have a longer channel on the spawn skill (1s > 45s)
    • The channeling player will grant a PvE received damage buff to their raid (100m range)

Bug Fixes

  • Bouncy Cows are no longer sneaky enough to avoid bloodlusting while using "Moo Away!"
  • Tier 2 Kraken Equipment has had their recipes properly set to require 1 Kraken Ink Sac
  • Ayanad Plate Small Mana Seals are now properly labelled.
  • Sapphire Dancing Queen has had its category corrected. It no longer identifies as a Dgn Bow, it prefers to be called a Dungeon Axe.
  • The Gallant Soulmare can now wear the Hoof-Harmony Armor set, available from the prestige shop.
  • Fixed an issue where Berserk Red Dragon Roar did not have the proper damage calculation intended.
  • Red Dragon's Devastator now shoots a projectile.
  • Red Dragon's Devastator's Ballista does not allow targeting it.
  • A peace zone has been added to the Guard Barracks in Marianople and the Isle of Penance.

Rules Update

The rules regarding in-game chat have been updated slightly (Sections B.4 and B.11).

Please note that posting links in-game will generally no longer be tolerated and may result in a mute (links such as guild Discord invites or links to our website remain safe.)

We appreciate all of the feedback we have been given through the first week of the World Boss Cycle: Tempest. Trust us, it'd be hard for us to miss. We'd like to let the dynamic timers created by the world boss eggs play out for just a bit longer, and in the meantime we are introducing some changes to make existing world boss items a bit more useful. Any and all feedback is appreciated, especially when it is constructively delivered. Thanks everyone!

== Features ==
* Rum Runner's Rapids Festival has been activated in Rookborne Basin! This will be running from July 8th to July 22nd (or the maintenance after that)
* The Howling Thundergod's Staff has been added to the game.
** Acquired through combining materials dropped by Thunderwing Titan
** The recipe is available at the Thunderwing Alchemy Workbench in Reedwind's camp
** This is the first of a series of weapons that will be crafted from Thunderwing Titan drops.
** Effects:
*** Passive - Increases all Lightning-Based Sorcery Skills Damage by +9%
*** Active - Fire up to 5 lightning artillery bolts up to 50 metres away, dealing (3250 + 290% Magic Attack) Damage. User is slowed by 15% for each remaining shot. Requires the staff to be equipped.
* A number of Red Dragon's weapons have had their actives improved.
** Berserk Red Dragon Roar (Staff)
*** 2.0s -> 1.5s cast time
*** +20% damage increase
*** 3m -> 5m radius of AOE
*** Combo: Deal 20% more damage to enemies affected by chilling or ice effects.
** Berserk Red Dragon's Wing-Reaper (Nodachi)
*** +30% damage increase
*** Inflicts '''Wing-Clipped''' instead of Slow:
**** 5s duration
**** 30% Slow
**** Affected targets cannot glide during the duration.
** Berserk Red Dragon Fireguard (Shield)
*** +3,000 -> +4,500 health regenerated over 10 seconds.
*** Fears all nearby enemies within 6m for up to 3 seconds.
** Berserk Red Dragon Tail-Reaper (Sword)
*** Channeling is no longer required for continuing the effect. Functions similarly to Crippling Mire.
*** Reduced scaling from Magic Attack, added base damage to the skill.
*** Effect now also slows attack speed and cast speed.
* The Red Dragon's Devastator has had its defenses reinforced.
** 15% damage reduction against all types of damage excluding siege
** Now immune to Red Dragon's meteorites.
** Small amount of in-combat health regeneration has been added.
** Cooldown has been reduced when engaging siege mode.
* The Red Dragon's Doom now has a salvage option similar to building material packs. Players will be returned a Hardened Red Dragon Scale when salvaged. No more porting away to drop pillaged harpoons!
* World Boss Spawners (Eggs, Gong) now have a longer channel on the spawn skill (1s > 45s)
** The channeling player will grant a PvE received damage buff to their raid (100m range)

== Bug Fixes ==
* Bouncy Cows are no longer sneaky enough to avoid bloodlusting while using "Moo Away!"
* Tier 2 Kraken Equipment has had their recipes properly set to require 1 Kraken Ink Sac
* Ayanad Plate Small Mana Seals are now properly labelled.
* Sapphire Dancing Queen has had its category corrected. It no longer identifies as a Dgn Bow, it prefers to be called a Dungeon Axe.
* The Gallant Soulmare can now wear the Hoof-Harmony Armor set, available from the prestige shop.
* Fixed an issue where Berserk Red Dragon Roar did not have the proper damage calculation intended.
* Red Dragon's Devastator now shoots a projectile.
* Red Dragon's Devastator's Ballista does not allow targeting it.
* A peace zone has been added to the Guard Barracks in Marianople and the Isle of Penance.

== Rules Update ==
The rules regarding in-game chat have been updated slightly (Sections B.4 and B.11).

Please note that posting links in-game will generally no longer be tolerated and may result in a mute (links such as guild Discord invites or links to our website remain safe.)
